name: 280L all-in-one system
tagline: A 280 litre R290 heat pump that plugs into a 10 amp power point.
summary: The Midea Smart Saver is an all-in-one heat pump hot water system. The 280 litre model suits families of three to five people.
It uses R290 refrigerant, plugs into a standard 10 amp power point, and has Wi-Fi control. A built-in electric heater backs up the heat pump in cold weather.

image.alt: Midea 280L all-in-one system, two white heat pump units

highlights.title: 10 amp plug
highlights.text: Plugs into a 10 amp power point, with overload and short-circuit protection.

highlights.title: R290 refrigerant
highlights.text: Runs on R290, a refrigerant with a global warming potential of 3.

highlights.title: Wi-Fi control
highlights.text: Wi-Fi enabled, with Economy, E-Heater and Hybrid modes to choose from.

highlights.title: Solar PV ready
highlights.text: In PV mode it uses surplus solar energy to heat water and store it for later.

highlights.title: Two-way disinfection
highlights.text: Heats the water to 60°C automatically or manually to prevent bacteria and legionella.

highlights.title: Easy to maintain
highlights.text: An easy-to-access E-Box, error codes and power outage memory simplify servicing.
